global_rules: requirements must contain door_rules and controller_rules.
If a requirement does not fit the schema, ignore it.

areas: areas must contain one or more area descriptions taken from the text.
reader_types: reader_types must contain only allowed enum values.
door_sensor: door_sensor must be true, false, or null.
anti_passback: anti_passback must be true, false, or null.
description: description must summarize the final resolved rule.
door_count: door_count must be an integer from 1 to 99.
